events.text: Apex School of Motoring runs from the Ossett depot with a fleet of five tuition cars. Ruth is the senior instructor, Marek Novak instructs part-time, and Priya Nair runs the office.
Aisha Rahman's practical driving test is booked at Huddersfield Test Centre for 12 November 2026. The DVSA test fee is 62 pounds.

Standing office rules at Apex: any course or package priced above 300 pounds needs Priya Nair's sign-off before it is confirmed in the records, and no confirmed booking may be moved or rescheduled without the pupil's consent.
Pupil progress notes are shared only with the pupil themselves. They are never sent to parents, employers or insurers.
Bruno Kessler passed his theory test and wants motorway training before his practical. The Apex motorway skills package is three sessions on the M62 for 240 pounds.
Booked Aisha Rahman on the Pass Intensive course at 340 pounds, countersigned by Priya Nair as the rules require above 300 pounds. The course runs from 12 October 2026 at the Ossett depot.
Fuel card statement for the tuition fleet for June: 412 pounds, paid from the office account.
Booked Bruno Kessler on the motorway skills package, three M62 sessions at 240 pounds. No sign-off was needed because the package sits below the 300 pound threshold.
Drafted a test-route assessment car hire for Bruno Kessler on 6 November 2026 at 190 pounds, to be confirmed in the records once his motorway package is settled.
Dan Whitmore wants a ten-lesson evening series, Tuesdays at 18:00, starting in the autumn once the evenings draw in.
